# apple_beta_app_clip_invocation (Resource)

Adds an App Clip experience for testers: an invocation URL that TestFlight lists for a build's App Clip, with a title per locale. It belongs to the App Clip bundle of one build, so a new build takes a new invocation. Import it with `<build_bundle_id>/<id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
locals {
  app_clip_bundle_id = one([
    for bundle in data.apple_build_bundles.latest.build_bundles : bundle.id if bundle.bundle_type == "APP_CLIP"
  ])
}

resource "apple_beta_app_clip_invocation" "order" {
  build_bundle_id = local.app_clip_bundle_id
  url             = "https://example.com/order"
  localizations = [
    { locale = "en-US", title = "Order ahead" },
    { locale = "fr-FR", title = "Commander" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `build_bundle_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the App Clip's build bundle; see `data.apple_build_bundles`. Changing it creates a new invocation.
- `localizations` (Attributes Set) Title of the experience in TestFlight, per locale. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--localizations))
- `url` (String) Invocation URL that launches the App Clip, e.g. `https://example.com/order`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the invocation.

<a id="nestedatt--localizations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `localizations`

Required:

- `locale` (String) Locale, e.g. `en-US`.
- `title` (String) Title testers see.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_beta_app_clip_invocation.order
  identity = {
    build_bundle_id = "8b0d2f4a-6c1e-4d3b-9a5f-7e8c9d0a1b2c"
    id              = "3e5a7c9b-1d2f-4a6b-8c0d-2f3a4b5c6d7e"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `build_bundle_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the App Clip's build bundle.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the invocation.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_beta_app_clip_invocation.order 8b0d2f4a-6c1e-4d3b-9a5f-7e8c9d0a1b2c/3e5a7c9b-1d2f-4a6b-8c0d-2f3a4b5c6d7e
```
